_comment: A firmware build that has the cloud client, on a gateway that can only run
one MQTT connection. The base fixtures are deliberately the build WITHOUT
the client (no cloud_* config keys at all) because the scenario overlay is
a deep merge and cannot remove a key — so the capability gate can only be
local_mqtt_disabled_reason 'one_connection' is what the firmware reports in
exactly this situation, so this one scenario covers both the Cloud page and
the held-down notice on the MQTT page.
